paper_title: A Subquadratic Bound for Online Bisection
statement: 7 Final Remarks In this paper, we provided the first algorithm for the online bisection problem with the competitive ratio of o(n2 ). Extending the result to a more general setting of online balanced graph partitioning (i.e., multiple-cluster case) is an intriguing open problem. We note that our algorithm Icb has non-polynomial running time; we conjecture that without resource augmentation, achieving a subquadratic competitive ratio in polynomial time is not possible.
